acceptance: session_client.rs defines `pub enum SessionClient { Acp(AcpStdioClient), Pi(PiSession) }` where `pub struct PiSession { client: PiRpcClient, session_id: String, session_new_result: serde_json::Value }`; constructors `pub fn from_acp(client: AcpStdioClient) -> Self` and `pub fn from_pi(client: PiRpcClient) -> Self` (from_pi copies client.session_id() once into the struct and sets session_new_result to json!({"sessionId": <id>}))

SessionClient offers EXACTLY the method set of AcpStdioClient listed in the API section, with identical names, receivers (&self / &mut self) and return types, each delegating to the Acp variant unchanged. #[cfg(test)] kill_host_for_test / child_id also exist (Pi variant: kill_host_for_test calls shutdown; child_id returns 0 and carries a `// ponytail:` comment that PiRpcClient exposes no pid yet)

Pi variant behavior: session_id returns the stored &str; shutdown and detach both call PiRpcClient::shutdown; host_exited calls the client's; poll_event/wait_event/begin_prompt/prompt_in_flight delegate; cancel calls PiRpcClient::cancel and on Ok returns CancelOutcome{permissions: vec![], elicitations: vec![]}; respond_client_request and respond_elicitation return Err("Pi RPC mode has no permission or elicitation requests".to_string()); session_new_result returns the stored value; apply_model_pin and apply_config_option return Err("model and option changes are not supported for Pi RPC yet".to_string()) with a `// ponytail:` comment naming the follow-up

session_client_tests.rs (declared in mod.rs as #[cfg(test)] mod session_client_tests;) spawns the fake via PiRpcClient::spawn, wraps with SessionClient::from_pi, and tests: session_id and session_new_result carry 'fake-pi-rpc-session-1'; prompt flow via begin_prompt + wait_event gives an AgentMessageChunk then RequestFinished with the returned id; cancel on an active `--hold-run` run returns an empty CancelOutcome and the run ends with stopReason cancelled; cancel with no run is Err; respond_client_request and respond_elicitation are Err; apply_model_pin and apply_config_option are Err; shutdown returns Some(id) once then None; use generous 10s waits

mod.rs gains only `mod session_client;`, `#[cfg(test)] mod session_client_tests;` and `pub use session_client::SessionClient;` (place them next to the other module lines); one explanatory #![allow(dead_code)] at the top of session_client.rs (nothing uses it yet); NO other file is modified; each new Rust file stays under 400 lines; no existing test modified
user_request: Add SessionClient: a two-variant enum wrapping either an AcpStdioClient or a PiRpcClient behind exactly the method set the web session slice already uses on AcpStdioClient, plus tests for the Pi variant. No call-site changes yet; nothing outside the three allowed files changes.
